description: The injury that took two weeks at 25 takes eight at 45, and the effort that maintained fitness no longer does.
energy_note: The same life, costing more to run.

aspect: Reading glasses arrive for nearly everybody
description: Presbyopia is effectively universal from the mid-forties. A small, certain, scheduled loss that nobody plans for and everybody gets.
Waking at 3am, or not getting back to sleep, becomes routine - and there is nothing to report to a doctor.
energy_note: Tired in a way with no diagnosis.

description: He notices, at 47, that he thinks about the stairs before taking them. Not pain. Just a calculation that did not used to happen.
energy_note: The first time your body appears in a decision.

description: Teeth accumulate work over decades and each intervention makes the next more likely, at increasing cost.
